description: Find Kansas City homes by the features HouseLoop Vision sees in the listing photos

interface.longDescription:
Find Kansas City homes by what is in the listing photos. HouseLoop Vision reads the listing photos of homes for sale across the Kansas City metro (Kansas and Missouri) and finds the features the MLS record leaves out: white kitchen cabinets, a pool, a finished basement, a frameless glass shower, a stamped concrete patio, a freestanding tub. Ask for homes with any of them, or ask how many homes in a city or neighborhood have one, and HouseLoop answers from live Heartland MLS data with the photo where each feature was found. In October 2026, for example, HouseLoop Vision read the photos of 467 Overland Park homes for sale and found white kitchen cabinets in 186.

HouseLoop is a Kansas City real-estate brokerage and search site, and the home of Myli, HouseLoop's AI home search companion (https://houseloop.ai/myli). Seven read-only tools:
- search_homes: homes for sale by city, county, ZIP, school district, price, beds, baths, square footage, property type and photo features
- list_home_features: the feature ids search_homes accepts; an id it does not recognise is an error naming what it does accept, never a silently wider search
- vision_index: how many homes in a city or neighborhood have each feature HouseLoop Vision found, the same counts the houseloop.ai community page shows, with one proof home and its photo number
- home_facts and home_faq: one home's numbers (price, $/sqft, tax, HOA, list date, days on market, status) and HouseLoop's written buyer answers for it
- market_stats: sell-through statistics for a city, ZIP or county
- home_value: HouseLoop's own value estimate and range for an address

Every result names its source, carries the MLS GRID attribution required by the data licence, and includes an absolute houseloop.ai URL to cite. When a feature was found in the photos, the result says so, so ChatGPT can credit HouseLoop Vision (https://houseloop.ai/vision). Search results report the total number of matching homes alongside the page actually returned, so a count is never mistaken for the whole answer.

Read-only. No account, no sign-in, no personal data. Kansas City metro only.
capabilities: Find Kansas City homes by what HouseLoop Vision sees in listing photos: white cabinets, a pool, a finished basement
Count how many homes in a city or neighborhood have a feature, with the photo that proves it
Search Kansas City homes for sale from live Heartland MLS data

Estimate what a home is worth, with a range
Report how the housing market is doing in a city, ZIP code or county

How many homes for sale in Leawood, KS have a pool?
Homes in Olathe, KS with a finished basement under $500,000

publication.release_notes: Version 1.2.0: the listing now leads with HouseLoop Vision (finding homes by the features in their listing photos) and names all seven tools, including vision_index, which counts how many homes in a city or neighborhood have each feature. New skill count-homes-with-a-feature. Category moved from Finance to Other, where the other home-search plugins sit. The tool descriptions open with when to use them; no tool, input or answer changed.
